extraction.Name: John Brooks
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent in fee to his SE4, of Sec.10, when he got it, as he did not want to pay taxes on it; but was told by the Indian Agency that he would have to take it, so he did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: deeded the land over to Mr. Dodendorf for this store bill, Mr. Dodendorf assuming the tax indebtedness
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in his taxes on his allotment, and was going in debt to the storekeeper, L.W. Dodendorf, for groceries, etc.
extraction.Occupation/Income: source of income is by farming his deceased mother's land
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is good; has a sick wife to support, she being bothered extremely bad with the stomach trouble; finds it hard to get along; has never received any help from the County or Government; allotment is SE4 of Sec. 10; document sworn November 15, 1928
